name: application-badges
title: Badges
description: Responsive badge and tag components with base badges, icon badges, dismissible badges, and themed variations for notifications, statuses, and labels in web applications and dashboards.
useWhen: Responsive badge and tag components with base badges, icon badges, dismissible badges, and themed variations for notifications, statuses, and labels in web applications and dashboards.
avoidWhen: Avoid badges when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Badges uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
